<title>show</title> Show submarine .sub files in the Git repository as a directory tree. - Unregistered files end with a red (U) - Registered files with a changed hash end with a yellow (M)
<title>export</title> Export .sub files as Git-friendly XML.
<cmd>export</cmd> Export all changed registered submarines <cmd>export</cmd> "test/My Sub1.sub" "test/My Sub2.sub" ... Export one or more registered submarines <cmd>export</cmd> "test/My Sub1.sub" -o ./mydir Export a submarine to the specified directory
Note: if a submarine or directory name contains spaces, quote the path; otherwise it will be parsed as multiple arguments.
<title>pack</title> Pack exported XML back into .sub.
<cmd>pack</cmd> "test/My Sub.xml" <cmd>pack</cmd> "test/My Sub.xml" -o ./mydir Pack into the specified directory
Note: if the output .sub already exists, it is backed up to .sub.bak first, then overwritten.
<title>unpack</title> Extract a submarine .sub file as raw XML. This command is rarely used.
<cmd>unpack</cmd> "test/My Sub.sub"
